description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a visionary nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and operational excellence. We are looking to fill this vital role urgently.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the delivery of high-quality patient care, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards. You will lead, mentor, and inspire a team of compassionate nursing professionals, fostering an environment of continuous improvement and exceptional service. This role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year.
requirements: Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Comprehensive understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Strong clinical and administrative management abilities

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This leadership role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to a compassionate care environment, supporting the Director of Nursing in overseeing clinical operations and ensuring the highest standards of patient care.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in staff supervision, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance. We are specifically looking for candidates with an RN background to bring strong clinical expertise to our team. This position offers a competitive salary range of $75,000 - $85,000 per year, reflecting your valuable experience and commitment to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Kansas
Previous experience in a leadership or supervisory nursing role, preferably in a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of long-term care regulations and quality assurance processes
Excellent clinical assessment, critical thinking, and communication skills
Ability to effectively lead, mentor, and manage nursing staff

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator (RN Preferred) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Olathe, KS. This full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate of $36-$40, providing an excellent opportunity for a professional passionate about resident care and compliance.As an MDS Coordinator, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, developing individualized care plans, and ensuring compliance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be vital in accurately reflecting resident acuity and ensuring appropriate reimbursement and quality care.This is a full-time position offering a stable and supportive environment. If you are an RN with MDS experience or a qualified professional eager to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current RN license preferred, or other relevant clinical licensure.
Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility.
In-depth knowledge of MDS 3.0 and associated federal and state regulations.
Strong assessment, care planning, and documentation skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00 based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD. This vital leadership role involves supporting the Director of Nursing in overseeing the clinical operations and ensuring the highest standards of patient care within our facility.

The ADON will play a crucial role in supervising nursing staff, implementing care policies, and maintaining compliance with all regulatory standards. This position offers an excellent opportunity to contribute to a compassionate care environment and make a significant impact on the lives of our residents.

This full-time position offers an annual salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, with compensation based on experience. We invite qualified candidates to apply and become a part of our committed healthcare team.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Maryland
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing experience, with some in a leadership or supervisory role
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $75,000 - $85,000, compensation based on experience.
